I said I would check and made no promise. CTO will want to see the security material before anything gets signed. Next step: she wants something she can forward to her VP, Daniel Okafor. detail: Page generated, revision 2; Using notes about Tom Reyes at Harbor Freight Lines

selected.message: Build a page Tom can forward to his CFO. Keep the agreed pilot price and start date and our promised SOC 2 delivery. Keep private reminders out.
sources: Demo with Tom Reyes, VP Operations at Harbor Freight Lines, Thursday. Tom said: 'onboarding slips every time a CSM changes.' They run about 25 onboardings a month. We agreed a 14-day pilot at 1,000 euros starting 1 December. I'll send the SOC 2 report by Friday. He asked about SSO with Okta, which we have today. He asked if we can do a custom Salesforce object. I said I need to check with engineering. I need to remember to loop in Sara on our side about the contract redlines. Next step: Tom will bring his CFO to a call next Wednesday at 15:00.
